description: DSH Measure agent-team rehearsal: a disposable Measure fixture, the Red/Green/Review protocol for DSH subagents, one executed rehearsal with the live guard, and the documented integration facts
deviation_notes: All 12 top-level tasks are done and the 4 phase checkpoints are recorded. Deviations: (1) The rehearsal established that a subagent spawned with the `subagent` tool's `cwd` option keeps the parent session's guard root (the child received this repository's plan problems and its fixture writes were outside the guard root), so the fixture's strict deny path was not exercised; the protocol was corrected to require a session whose working directory is the fixture, and `dsh --profile headless` was probed and cannot host the guard (webServer inject pending, no stored LLM credentials). The Red→Green→commit cycle itself was executed for real. (2) A fresh review caught that a cross-track Phase 5 (the band follow-up reconciliation) had been added to this plan with an open task, which would have blocked the closeout; it was removed and its work (commit 75f00f8, checkpoint 5d9e270) is recorded here as a separate cross-track correction. (3) The review also made the Green rule exact: strict mode needs that agent's own test-file change AND failed run, so a Green that only runs the Red test is still denied; the protocol and spec were corrected. (4) Follow-up review (dsh_measure_rehearsal_followup_20261107): the corrected FR-3 requires a session whose working directory is the fixture; the executed run used subagents of the main session, so the strict deny path was not exercised. This is an Accepted Risk recorded in spec-review.md, not a claimed proof. The Host has a `session.create` remote that accepts a `cwd` ("Directory the Session owns"), but it is only reachable through the authenticated GUI API (a bare HTTP call returns 401), not from the agent tool surface; the true isolated-session rehearsal is deferred to a future track. The follow-up also corrected the "measure/ always allowed" rule and the reference summary, and hardens the fixture contract test to assert a real commit.
